recommendation:
VERDICT: REJECT Chapter 9 (Talents & Abilities) as a publishable unit. Topic t-01 closed 7 refutes to 0 supports, all seven refutes un-rebutted, a terminal reject-majority against the charter's quorum of 4; no judge was convened, no impasse was declared and no ruling was sealed, so rulings_applied is empty by construction. The card set and the arithmetic spine are CLEARED: 42 cards parse exactly as 21 Talents + 4 Basic Attacks + 17 Weapon Maneuvers with no tables; every maneuver Discipline count sits on the 1/2/3 ladder with no outlier; costs are the flat 2/4/8 DP with the Level 3 and Level 7 gates; all three @sec-* tokens resolve and no typed stop follows one; exactly one {=typst} fence; zero em-dashes and zero damage dice on the file; the four Basic Attacks use the sanctioned 1/1/2 and 1/2/3 floors; and Death Blow's 6 to an adjacent enemy lands on the Novice Strong row. Three clusters reached the whole council and one sub-claim is dismissed (see rationale). Disposition, tiered and decision-oriented; every item names the site, the broken value, the expected value and the minimal fix.

SHIPPED IN THE COUNCIL-PASS COMMIT (a8b496d, PR #482), verified on current main:
1. [09-talents-abilities:13,15 + 21-glossary:85] Broken: talents defined as unconditionally passive while seven of twenty-one Talent cards carry an activation (Fortune's Favor, Refuse to Fall, Miracle Worker, Chaotic Insight are Reactions; Battlefield Assessment an Action; Quick Study Free; Rally the Troops a Maneuver), and the glossary named Fortune's Favor as its activation-free example. Expected: the definition admits activated talents and names the Action field as the tell. Fix shipped: 'Most talents are passive ... a few are activated talents, and their card's Action field says so', glossary example reworded (f-005, f-006; f-001 corroborates).
2. [09-talents-abilities:41] Broken: Combat Reflexes Adept granted '+1 Initiative', a +N modifier to a roll, which the Boon/Bane law forbids outside its three named exceptions (Initiative is a 3d6 + Agility roll). Expected: a Boon. Fix shipped: 'a Boon on your Initiative roll' (f-001, f-003).
3. [09-talents-abilities:43, 09-talents-abilities:113] Broken: two passive cards failed the template's strict-superset rule at Master (Combat Reflexes dropped the Adept initiative bonus; Death Blow dropped the adept adjacent-target splash). Expected: the higher rank strictly contains the lower. Fix shipped: both Master lines now carry the lower effect forward (f-001, f-002).
4. [09-talents-abilities:301] Broken: 'Each is gated by weapon Disciplines' is false for Shield Slam (2 Armor, canon at 08-disciplines:122) and Renewal (1 Protection). Expected: the blanket claim scoped. Fix shipped: the sentence now names both exceptions (f-006).
5. [09-talents-abilities:529,531 and 09-talents-abilities:129] Broken: usage-limit drift (Renewal hid 'once per scene' inside the Action field while every other limited card states it in the body; Miracle Worker's Novice row trailed its frequency where its own Adept row led with it). Expected: one placement, body-side. Fix shipped: Renewal's limit moved into the Weak line; Miracle Worker Novice now leads with the frequency (f-005, f-002).

OPEN, MECHANICAL (chapter-local; the load-bearing remaining item):
6. [09-talents-abilities:307-311 Riposte, :335-339 Cyclone, :377-381 Shield Slam, :391-395 Parry, :447-451 Brace] Broken: five of the seven numeric-row maneuvers print a base row one or two tiers below the tier their own Discipline count sets. Tier equals rank count (08-disciplines:133, 08-disciplines:208), the budget keys damage to tier (08-disciplines:228-230), canon states 'An Adept Brimstone Burst deals 6/9/12' (08-disciplines:240) and Flat takes 'the budget row exactly as listed' (08-disciplines:246). Expected bases: Riposte 2/4/6 to 6/9/12; Parry's DR row +2/+4/+6 to +6/9/12; Brace's 'the attacker takes 2/4/6' to 6/9/12; Shield Slam 1/2/3 to 6/9/12 (Shield Slam is canonised as the two-rank Adept example at 08-disciplines:122); Cyclone 2/4/6 to 9/15/21. Dual Strike and Renewal, both one rank, are already on-row. Fix: raise the five bases; each card's existing Adept and Master lines are already correct. Two members read these lines the other way (f-001 and f-004 expected the Novice row 2/4/6 and flagged only Shield Slam); the tier-keyed reading is adopted on the canon above (see rationale).
7. [09-talents-abilities:61,63] Broken: Weapon Focus Adept and Master print '+2 damage tiers' and '+3 damage tiers', but the only sanctioned damage booster is the tier bump 'always phrased +1 damage tier'. Expected: single-step phrasing (or an explicit multi-tier grant rule). Fix: restate both lines as +1 damage tier (f-004, f-002).
8. [09-talents-abilities:17 with :59-63, :219-223, :321-329, :363-371, :433-441, :475-483, :489-497] Broken: the chapter sanctions 'Bonuses from different talents stack' and ships multiple uncapped +1-tier boosters, yet only Death Blow states a ceiling ('maximum 21'); two or more boosters on one hit leave the printed table entirely (a Master Strong 21 has no row above it). Expected: every result lands on a row. Fix: one global rule (no result rises above its card's Strong row; absolute maximum 21) applied to every tier-boost effect, the way 15-equipment:220 already caps its own charge locally (f-002).

OPEN, DESIGN JUDGMENT (veto-able defaults, none blocking a build):
9. [09-talents-abilities:307-315 and :528-539] Riposte is a usage-limit-free Reaction counterattack and only Renewal prints a limit; extra Reactions from Combat Reflexes therefore convert to repeated full-damage counters within a round. Default: leave the family limit-free and let the Reaction economy (22-reference-sheets:61, 1/round) plus the extra-Reaction talent's own DP cost govern it; if a cap is wanted, add it to Reaction maneuvers uniformly, not to one card (f-002).

OPEN, LAYOUT (verify on a fresh build):
10. [rendered book, the card band] Broken: five of the forty-two cards were split by a page turn and one heading was stranded at a page foot (f-007). Expected: each card holds together so a GM can read one card in one place. Note: the theme changed twice after the sampled PDF (orphaned-heading fix #84/#476, continuous folios #478), so re-verify on a clean build and, only if the tearing persists, bind each card in a keep-together block. Confine the fix to the card band; card text is not touched.

ROUTED OUT (neighbouring file, not ch09's to fix):
11. [07-skills:132] The Parry disambiguation sentence points at @sec-chapter-combat for the weapon maneuver, but the maneuver cards live in this chapter and combat itself points readers here (13-combat:81); repoint the ch07 sentence.

VERIFIED NOT a defect (do not re-open):
- f-006's missing-Duration-field claim is dismissed. No card in any chapter prints a Duration field; the spell chapters fold duration into the Range parenthetical (e.g. ch11 cantrips read 'Touch (Concentration, up to 1 minute)'), and 09-talents-abilities:15's field list matches the printed headers. This is a book-wide Card Template v2 question, not a ch09 blocker.
- The Basic Attacks are on the sanctioned floor: Basic Melee 1/2/3 + Brawn (attribute-scaled Novice base, 08-disciplines:248), Basic Archery and Basic Thrown 1/2/3 flat, Basic Unarmed 1/1/2 + Brawn (15-equipment:60).
- Rally the Troops Master's 'Frightened or Dazed' uses the sanctioned binary condition name; Dazed's leveled form appears only where a level is carried.
- Linguist (1 Lore) and Battlefield Assessment (1 Tactics) gate on real Disciplines (08-disciplines:57-58), and Shield Slam's Armor / Renewal's Protection gates are canon.
- All 42 card names are collision-free against every other chapter as card names; the only name reuse is the ch07 Parry skill, already disambiguated and adjudicated there.
rationale: Seven members filed on topic t-01; all seven refuted, none supported, and no finding carries a rebuttal, so seven refutes stand against the charter's quorum of 4 and the topic closes on a terminal reject-majority. No judge was needed and no ruling was sealed, so rulings_applied is empty by construction. The refutes converge on three clusters rather than on a single defect. (1) The Talent category contradicts itself: f-005 (author) and f-006 (editor-in-chief) independently found that the chapter and 21-glossary:85 call talents activation-free while seven Talent cards carry an activation, and f-001 (librarian) carried the same mismatch in evidence. (2) Two passive cards break the template's superset rule: f-001 and f-002 agree on Combat Reflexes (Master drops the Adept initiative bonus) and f-001 alone caught Death Blow (Master drops the adept adjacent-target splash). (3) Combat Reflexes' '+1 Initiative' is the last numeric roll modifier standing after the Boon/Bane wave, flagged independently by f-001 and f-003. f-006 adds the false gating sentence at 09:301, canon-confirmed by 08-disciplines:122, and f-005 adds the usage-limit placement drift. All five of those clusters were implemented in the council-pass commit a8b496d (PR #482) and verified on current main. Two member positions required adjudication. FIRST, the maneuver base rows. f-003 (researcher) filed five numeric-row maneuvers as one or two tiers low; f-001 and f-004 read the same lines and concluded that flat maneuvers simply open on the Novice row, so only Shield Slam (printing the non-row 1/2/3) was a defect, expected 2/4/6. The tier-keyed reading is adopted. The reasons: 08-disciplines:133 and :208 make a card's tier equal its prerequisite count (Shield Slam's 2 Armor makes it Adept); 08-disciplines:228-230 key the damage row to that tier; 08-disciplines:240 gives the worked statement 'An Adept Brimstone Burst deals 6/9/12', and Brimstone Burst is itself a two-rank card whose printed base is 6/9/12; 08-disciplines:246 says Flat takes the row exactly as listed; and 08-disciplines:122 canonises Shield Slam as the two-rank Adept example, which fixes its expected base at 6/9/12, not 2/4/6. The ch12 siblings corroborate (2 Religion/2 Life cards print the Adept row as their base), and the ch08 council's own Pillar of Light ruling (decisions-pending #23) fixed a two-rank card that printed the wrong row to the Adept row and fixed Hallowed Ground's DR row to 6/9/12, which is exactly Parry's shape. So f-003's five-card count stands and f-001/f-004 were under-corrected on Shield Slam; the correction does not change any card's live damage value because each card's Adept line already prints the right row. SECOND, f-006's Duration claim is dismissed after checking the whole book: no chapter prints a Duration header field, and the spell chapters fold duration into the Range parenthetical, so 09:15 describes its own headers accurately; this is a template-spec question routed out, not a ch09 defect. f-002's stacking finding survives as open: the chapter permits talent bonuses to combine and ships multiple uncapped tier boosters while only Death Blow states 'maximum 21', and 15-equipment:220 shows the local ceiling already exists elsewhere in the book, so the fix is one global ceiling rule. f-004's Weapon Focus finding also survives: the only sanctioned booster phrasing is '+1 damage tier', so '+2/+3 damage tiers' are outside it. f-007's page-flow finding is layout and is recorded for re-verification because the theme changed after the sampled PDF. One cross-chapter nit was routed out (07-skills:132 points at combat for a maneuver that lives here). Net: the numeric and taxonomic spine is clean, the cleared ground is large (42-card set, ranks, costs, gates, labels, fences, dashes, dice, basic floors), and the reject rests on a short, fully-enumerated list.

resolved.outcome: Terminal reject: seven of seven refuted, no support, all seven un-rebutted against a quorum of 4; Chapter 9 is not publishable as written, though every numeric and taxonomic value it prints is cleared. Already shipped in a8b496d (PR #482): the talent definition and its glossary mirror, the Combat Reflexes Initiative conversion to a Boon, the Combat Reflexes and Death Blow Master supersets, the false gating sentence at 09:301, and the Renewal and Miracle Worker usage-limit placement. Still open for the implementation pass: (Tier 1 mechanical) raise the five off-tier maneuver bases (Riposte, Parry, Brace, Shield Slam to 6/9/12; Cyclone to 9/15/21), restate Weapon Focus to single-step +1 damage tier, and add one global tier-boost ceiling (no result above Strong for its card's rank, absolute maximum 21); (Tier 2 default) leave Reaction maneuvers limit-free unless a uniform cap is preferred; (Tier 3 layout) re-verify card page-flow on a clean build and bind cards only if the tearing persists. Routed out: 07-skills:132's combat pointer. Dismissed: the Duration-field sub-claim. No sealed rulings applied.

dissent.position: Refuted and stands; counter-signal on the cleared spine: verified the 42-card set (21/4/17, no tables), all 17 maneuver rank counts on the ladder, the 2/4/8 costs and Level 3/7 gates, three resolving @sec labels, one typst fence, zero em-dashes and the figure-number offset. Its three defect clusters (Initiative Boon, the two superset breaks, Shield Slam off-row) all hold; its Shield Slam expected value 2/4/6 is adopted one step further at the canon-fixed 6/9/12.

Refuted and stands; its stress test of the budget is what surfaced the missing global tier-boost ceiling (Weapon Focus plus Dangerous Gambit plus a maneuver exits the table while only Death Blow caps at 21), and it corroborated the Combat Reflexes superset break. Its Reaction-limit and Riposte points are recorded as a veto-able design default, not as a hard defect. Adopted.

Refuted and stands; its programmatic read is the finding the disposition rests on: five of the seven numeric-row maneuvers print a base below their own rank's tier, and the numeric-roll sweep leaves exactly one survivor (Combat Reflexes' Initiative). Its card count, rank ladder, reference resolution, fence count, dash sweep and dice sweep are all confirmed. Adopted.

Refuted and stands on Weapon Focus: '+2/+3 damage tiers' exceed the single sanctioned '+1 damage tier' booster. Its Shield Slam finding is adopted but its expected value is corrected: the canon-fixed base is 6/9/12 (Shield Slam is the two-rank Adept example at 08-disciplines:122), not the Novice row 2/4/6; on the other four off-tier maneuvers it read the printed Novice base as intentional, which the tier-keyed budget does not support.

Refuted and stands; its two findings (the passive-versus-activated Talent contradiction with the glossary, and the usage-limit placement drift at Renewal 09:529 and Miracle Worker 09:129) were both implemented in a8b496d. Its voice findings are accepted; no part of this finding is rebutted.

Refuted and stands on two of three: the passive-versus-activated contradiction (with the glossary) and the false 'gated by weapon Disciplines' sentence at 09:301 are implemented in a8b496d. Its third claim, that every card lacks a Duration header field, is dismissed: no chapter prints a Duration field and the spell chapters fold duration into Range, so 09:15 accurately describes its own headers.

Refuted and stands as the only render-lens finding: five of forty-two cards were split by a page turn and one heading was stranded at a page foot, with no keep-together wrapper on the card band. Recorded as an open layout item to re-verify on a clean build because the theme changed twice after the sampled PDF (#84/#476 orphaned-heading fix, #478 continuous folios); not re-litigated.
